description: SWARM Research Report - Full Markdown report on any topic, researched on the live web, every claim linked to its source. 2-4 min (allow 360 s). Returns Markdown. $0.99. Pays in USDC on Base via x402 when SWARM_WALLET_KEY is set (quote checked against SWARM_MAX_USD first; charged only on success). On failure it says whether you were charged and if a retry is safe; it never retries on its own.
